problem: Consumed response text is lost to canary observation when public call rejects on HTTP status, JSON parsing or the existing length bound; interruptedRun drops configured extraTexts; missing capture must not be treated as zero by report aggregation.

recommendedOption.name: Private per-run public-client rebinding with synchronous transient body scan and explicit scoped completeness
recommendedOption.publicCompatibility: No new required createPublicApiClient/StudioApiClient/DriveOptions business argument or public checker. Standalone client continues to work. Programmable doubles retain fulfilled-response behavior but cannot claim unobservable raw HTTP completeness.
recommendedOption.privateOwnership: A private WeakMap associates the actual returned public client object with a factory bound to its original immutable transport/base/token/scope settings. withTextCapture creates a fresh internally observed client per driver invocation. The factory observer/canary set/closed counters belong only to that run, never a shared current-observer slot. Raw-client identity registration is not inferred from arbitrary forwarded methods.
captureFlow: Driver entry copies its canary set and creates the run-local observation state/observed-client clone; original method arguments and request behavior remain.

Each actual call registers an attempt; after response.text fulfills, synchronously inspect the entire consumed string BEFORE length, JSON or status rejection. Observer retains only fixed-label redacted findings/counters.
Only then enforce the original text.length<=2000000 condition, parse JSON with sanitized diagnostics, and apply the original HTTP rejection or successful return.
Successful decoded method bodies still pass in full through withTextCapture before FR06-01 tuple checks; raw rejected bodies are NOT inserted as fulfilled start/session replies.
At existing scan/accounting boundaries merge redacted raw findings, existing fulfilled-value/receipt findings and configured supplied-text findings; copy closed observation status into the run.

Both normal return and catch recovery await their final observation work BEFORE finally disposes run-owned transient state. A return of an unawaited interruptedRun promise must not trigger cleanup early.
recommendedOption.concurrency: Two interleaved drivers sharing one original actual public-client object obtain distinct bound clones/counters/canary sets. Disposing one can neither detach nor clear the other. No async ambient/global observer and no cross-run mutable canary list.
recommendedOption.rawMemory: Raw failure strings stay only in the already-existing response.text call scope and the synchronous scanner. No raw reservoir, event queue, error property, run field, log or artifact. For arbitrary over-bound consumed strings, use non-copying indexOf/non-overlap counting with existing variantsOf semantics; retain only per-canary aggregates, not per-body text or an unbounded body list. This is not a new streaming response bound: response.text still allocates first, as today.

rawAndErrorRules.preservedBounds: Exactly2000000 UTF-16 code units remains allowed, over-limit remains rejected, existing30s request signal/driver budgets unchanged. Scan the entire already consumed over-bound text including the tail, without retaining a truncated/full extra body copy.
rawAndErrorRules.unavailable: If transport/body read/scanner cannot establish complete consumed-text inspection, keep known hits and sticky unavailable status; partial/failed body read is not an empty response. Unknown counts/counters use null where not observed.
rawAndErrorRules.fixedLabels: New raw channel uses a source-fixed label such as publicHttp, never URL/path/header/body/statusText/exception text. Cumulative findings keep only existing label/canaryIndex/canarySha256Prefix/hits fields and are monotonic; repeated phase merging uses max of cumulative counts rather than resumming the same body.
rawAndErrorRules.safeErrors: Keep fixed refusal/bound messages and HTTP numeric status. Replace raw JSON.parse diagnostics and untrusted transport/error causes with fixed value-free diagnostics; never attach raw body, parsed object, original cause, hint or statusText.
rawAndErrorRules.codeProjection: Preserve recognized public error vocabulary by selecting trusted source literals from a closed map (v3 error enum plus declared legacy route literals, explicitly including STALE_REVISION). Unrecognized strings or structured error objects become null, not raw code metadata; nested platform error.code may be recognized only by that same map. A regex accepting arbitrary body text is insufficient. No backend/controller error vocabulary changes.
rawAndErrorRules.standalone: Sanitized error propagation applies even without a driver observer; no observer/canary configuration is required for ordinary standalone usage. Such usage produces no run completeness claim.

extraTextsAndInterruption.normalSchedule: Keep the existing successful scan boundaries. Supplied texts are a separately admitted independent text snapshot, not a new provider/API observer introduced by this fix.
extraTextsAndInterruption.interrupt: Pass the existing configured hook/state into interruptedRun instead of forcing null. Collect at most once for the admitted interruption stage when the failing stage has not already attempted collection. If the primary failure is from a collector/scanner stage, reuse that stage outcome; never retry the hook in catch.
extraTextsAndInterruption.failure: Record fixed unavailable status, keep all earlier known findings and sanitized original failure context, and continue original incomplete-run recovery. A later successful snapshot does not silently erase a failed-scope fact. Do not throw arbitrary collector error text or mask a primary API failure.
extraTextsAndInterruption.partialMap: Retain hits from successfully inspected strings even if another supplied field is malformed; mark coverage unavailable. Do not place untrusted body/error content into finding labels. Existing source-declared labels such as backendLog may stay; undeclared labels use fixed ordinal aliases.
extraTextsAndInterruption.noHook: NOT_CONFIGURED is explicit and never global zero. CLI still supplies no global gateway/log/SSE/audit collector; external full-stack coverage and positive/human canary evidence stay owed.
extraTextsAndInterruption.lifetime: Await all admitted collection before disposing run-local state; release only owned text/variant/observer references after closed snapshots are copied into results. No detached collection/retry/background observer.
extraTextsAndInterruption.pendingHook: No new timeout/window value or hidden I/O retry is introduced. A provided collector must remain an owner-bound finite text provider as in the existing contract; a nonsettled collection cannot return a complete record or PASS. Future runtime admission must bind that existing collector/read scope, rather than infer availability.

accountingAndStops.observerMustNotLatch: The synchronous raw observer only accumulates redacted facts/status; it never records a session or calls stopRule.observeHardGate/record itself.
accountingAndStops.interruptedOrder: Preserve current interruptedRun known/potential-start accounting FIRST, then merge observations and latch hard-gate facts. An error/malformed canary response to startSession may conceal a started session and must still incur exactly the existing conservative potential-start charge with unknown usage.
accountingAndStops.postBase: Failing GET/PUT after base publication retains exactly the already charged base; no suffix,409 retry, new learn/model call or second base charge.
accountingAndStops.captureFailure: At a normal scan boundary, a configured scanner/collector failure enters the existing controlled observation-unavailable recovery without discarding known sessions/hits. Unsupported scripted clients in HARNESS_SELF_TEST keep legacy driver behavior with raw coverage UNOBSERVABLE; no mandatory new double method is added.
accountingAndStops.preserved: Current revisions/CAS, full successful capture before tuple checks, guided string contracts, deadlines, at-most-once and all UNKNOWN/uncertain-start semantics remain. No stop-rule policy/function or corpus semantic-validator change.

minimalCoverageAndReport.perRunLocation: One closed row in existing details.canaryObservation; no new top-level RunRecord schema or unrelated CauseAssessment use.

rowFields.httpAttempts: nonnegative integer or null if unobservable
rowFields.httpBodiesConsumed: count of response.text successful full-string returns, not wire octets
rowFields.httpBodiesScanned: nonnegative count or null if unobservable

minimalCoverageAndReport.completeness: Require exactly one valid closed row, publicHttp COMPLETE, complete consumed/scanned attempt accounting, fulfilledValues COMPLETE and every configured extra-text operation complete. Missing/malformed row, unsupported raw capture or any unavailable required local stage is UNKNOWN, never grandfathered as complete. No-hook scopes remain explicitly excluded from global coverage.
minimalCoverageAndReport.existingFailurePath: Use existing details.driverObservations/OBSERVATION_UNAVAILABLE with fixed internal reason, and add a narrow RUN_CANARY_OBSERVATION_UNAVAILABLE problem to existing validateRunRecord/buildBenchmark D_C paths when required local observation is incomplete. Do not overload learnSessionsComplete or the three CauseAssessment fields.
minimalCoverageAndReport.allAttempts: Evaluate coverage across the entire original run population, including earlier excluded/infrastructure attempts. One unknown local capture prevents aggregate GATE_PASS even if completions remain>=90% or a later retry is clean. Preserve existing INVALID/INCOMPLETE verdict vocabulary and positive hard facts.
minimalCoverageAndReport.compatibleKnownCounts: Keep existing hardGates shape/numeric confirmed-hit-run counts as observed lower bounds; do not omit secretOrPiiLeak and rely on ??0 to mean unknown.
minimalCoverageAndReport.smallAdditiveSummary: Add only a scoped canaryObservation summary beside existing report fields: scope, complete, knownLeakRuns, totalLeakRuns (null when incomplete), unknownRun identities, globalWireComplete:null. Empty population is incomplete/null. This is local observation accounting, not a new independent QA/cause-review system or global stack attestation.
minimalCoverageAndReport.types: Document the closed detail row and additive optional summary for older serialized reports in evaluate.d.mts; existing StudioApiClient method/response contracts remain unchanged. Historical records lacking metadata stay unknown under new scoring; old sealed reports are untouched.

candidateFiles.scope: Private factory/observer binding, transient raw scan, safe errors, interruption collector state/awaited disposal, closed local completeness gate/summary. Preserve stop-rule/corpus-validator semantics.
Closed optional observation/report typings/comments only; no required caller business options or public checker.
New WIRE-OBS18 injected full-public-adapter/driver/cross-run/collector/accounting/gating tests; retain all existing31 affected controls and real-fixture tests without weakening.

Minimal explicit complete local-observation premise in syntheticRuns UNIT-ONLY fixture, preserving existing scoring assertions. Root explicitly accepted this fourth existing target; no actual corpus/body/oracle change and no missing-real-coverage exemption.

testMatrix.case: Non2xx JSON body with canary through the actual public adapter; known HTTP status/STALE_REVISION preserved, unknown code/error object cannot retain raw text; no repeated request.
Malformed JSON with canary and success/empty success controls. Capture precedes parsing; serialized run/error/code/cause contain no raw value/parser excerpt; existing full2xx FR06 capture remains.

Exactly-at2000000 UTF-16 units valid JSON allowed; over-limit body with canary beyond that prefix is scanned fully once then rejected by unchanged fixed bound. No raw body attached/retained after completion.

Injected response.text failure or observation failure yields unknown local coverage/total=null, preserves any earlier canary, never0-complete or successful wire claim. Unsupported custom double remains usable but raw scope is UNOBSERVABLE.

Interrupted API path invokes supplied collector once and finds its canary. Collector throw/malformed snapshot follows fixed unavailable path, prior hits survive, raw exception/labels do not leak, and no retry occurs when collection itself caused interruption.

Canary-bearing rejected/malformed start reply preserves one conservative potential-start charge and unknown session/usage scope before latch; post-base GET/PUT failure retains one base charge, no suffix/retry/extra charge.

Use a strictly valid in-memory all-local UNIT corpus (>=20 existing local cases, derived gate/sessionPlan/digest recomputed only in memory) and explicit synthetic observation premises. Baseline reaches GATE_PASS; one unknown/missing capture keeps>=90% completion yet becomes non-PASS with null local total. An earlier excluded unknown cannot be erased by a later complete retry.

Two interleaved drivers share ONE actual createPublicApiClient object, distinct canary sets and gated response.text promises. Confirm per-run capture ownership/no contamination, and one cleanup cannot detach the still-running observer. Do not use only forwarded selected methods as proof of registry integration.

externalBoundary: Default CLI remains without a global gateway/log/SSE/audit collector. publicHttp COMPLETE and local total0 never imply global wire0, actual provider/model/token/cost/headroom/security/human/pilot acceptance; globalWireComplete stays null and existing requiredActualEvidence persists.
openDesignFacts: Independent design review has not yet occurred. Concrete findings should be resolved in a minimal successor.
Recognition list for safe error codes must use only trusted existing contract/route literals; arbitrary legacy ErrorResponse.error is open text and cannot safely be preserved verbatim.
Actual external collector finiteness/read permission/membership and whole-stack scope are future owner/admission facts, not supplied by this local design.
